title: FW↔SEC-001: Secure Boot Implementation + mTLS Conformance
description: Security provides secure-boot, mTLS, key-storage, and anti-rollback implementation specifications plus threat-model findings; Firmware implements the controls to specification and returns conformance evidence. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.2 and FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.6. Maps to the mandatory production security baseline.

baseline_version.description: Security baseline version being conformed to.

controls.description: Mandatory firmware security-baseline controls with conformance status.

mtls.description: Mutual TLS with X.509 device certificates.

secure_key_storage.description: Hardware root of trust / secure key handling.

mutual_auth.description: Both client and server X.509 certificates validated.

cert_validation_enabled.description: No disabled verification; no self-signed certs in production.

items.description: Path/URI to evidence (boot-chain log, handshake pcap, key-provisioning record).

threat_findings_addressed.description: Threat-model finding IDs addressed by this implementation.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Security-baseline implementation (secure boot, mTLS, anti-rollback) — ESC-SEC; SEC owns binding decisions and HG-01 release veto. Any baseline weakening is non-overridable by agents.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (baseline/spec handoff at planning); secure-boot and transport-security implementation reviews; pre-production hardening sign-off
confirm_conditions: mtls_conformance: tls_version = TLS1.3, mutual_auth = true, cert_validation_enabled = true
conformance_evidence present for each implemented control
anti_rollback IMPLEMENTED via monotonic counter (mitigates FMEA FC-026 residual risk)
reject_conditions: any control PARTIAL/NOT_IMPLEMENTED at pre-production sign-off (ESC-SEC; HG-01 veto)
cert_validation_enabled = false or self-signed certs in production
TLS below 1.3 without an accepted-risk ADR signed by SEC + ARCH
missing conformance evidence for a claimed-IMPLEMENTED control
counter_conditions: a control IMPLEMENTED but evidence incomplete — request the evidence artifact before sign-off
baseline_version older than current — request re-conformance against the latest baseline
